stem.text: An enzyme is modified for industrial use. It has a lower Michaelis-Menten constant ($K_\text{m}$) than the unmodified enzyme.
What is true of the modified enzyme?

B.text: It has a higher affinity for its substrate.

C.text: It has a lower maximum rate of reaction ($V_\text{max}$).

D.text: It needs more substrate to become saturated.
